reviews.text:
We were humiliated while our Vizsla was dying. We brought him there weakly, with bruises that had formed in 1 day.
He was an indoor dog, he was with them all day, we knew that nothing had happened to him. Dr. Zsolt Sebestyén, spoke to us like animal abusers, saying that this dog had been kicked, or at least hit by a car.
He didn't check his recent blood results, he said he knew what had happened...
I came crying and I even had to pay for it.
We took him somewhere else immediately.
It turned out that he had cancerous "Hemangiosarcoma", an extremely aggressive and malignant tumor that starts in the walls of blood vessels, which causes bruises.
Unfortunately, he couldn't help him, but he didn't even try to find out what was wrong.
He didn't do anything except humiliate us.

Our dog is almost 14 years old, has serious chronic condition that requires constant antibiotics treatments. We been going to this clinic for more than 10 years, doctors and team are wonderful here. If it wasnt for their determination and expertise and attention, our Rocky probably wont be here long time ago. And i am eternally thankful particularly to Dr Polgar, he loves animals and he is a great veterinarian, kind and knowledgeable. Thank you all!! 🎈❤️

Terrible place! My 1-month-old kitten died in the waiting room, the patient who arrived for the appointment was taken first, who had a problem with his eyes. The sick kitten was not examined, not even by the doctor who worked at the computer. The assistant was the only one who was nice, she brought a hot water bottle. I waited for half an hour, my kitten died in my lap. :( when they looked at it, they said it died, you can leave it there for 8,000 HUF. Pathetic! :(
I can only write the best, highlighting the immense expertise.💗 …
If I could I would give it 0. I would not recommend this shoddy office to anyone. The doctor was condescending and a jerk, the place was dirty...
Correct, thorough eye examination. Clear, understandable explanation of the treatment and examinations. Clean environment, high prices

I cannot recommend the clinic to anyone. After our male dog was neutered, his scrotum became very swollen, we took him back for an examination, they gave him medicine but he did not improve. We then asked him several times if this was okay, and we were always told not to worry, that it was normal, and the swelling would go down. On the day of the suture removal, the dog was so sick that even lying down/sitting down was very painful for him. On the day of the suture removal, we indicated to the doctor as laymen that perhaps something should be done about the swelling first, and only then remove the suture, but for reasons that were completely incomprehensible to me, the doctor still removed the suture from the dog's scrotum, which was already swollen to the size of a man's diploma. The suture was not removed by Dr. Sebestyen, but he showed it to him. The dog was given antibiotics for the swelling, which of course didn't help. As expected, 2 days after the stitches were removed, the poor dog's stitches opened and blood was flowing from the wound. We took him back to the clinic, where Dr. Sebestyen examined him, then sent us home with a dog bleeding from the open wound to show him again in a week (it was a Saturday). I find it shocking that people spend a lot of money on a neutering operation, and then they show such irresponsible, completely unprofessional behavior. Sending an animal home with an open, bleeding wound??? After all, I made a series of mistakes that eventually led to this? I understand that the appointment was already over on Saturday afternoon, but this was due to their mistake. The dog also had to be operated on that day. He had a huge tumor in his scrotum because a vein was not properly closed. He would have lost a significant amount of blood in 2 days. I really don't understand how they could send us home with a dog in such a condition??? Unfortunately, I also see that the team at the surgery is completely exhausted and the focus is not on treatment.
Plus, the dog was sedated to such a level for the operation that he was unlucky one day before he fully recovered.

Five years ago, our puppy died after 2 days of injection/tablet treatment. Then it turned out that he had internal bleeding, The doctors there did not recognize this. This week's case: three days after examination and "treatment" (he could not walk due to a splinter), when changing the bandage, another centimeter of splinter came out of the wound. Terrible examination, we will never go there again!
Always professional care, proper information, both the veterinarians and the assistants are very kind and caring towards the pets and their owners! Thank you!

We visited Dr. Zsolt Sebestyén for an orthopedic appointment, and we were completely satisfied! The doctor was patient, thorough, kind, and examined our timid vizsla with great expertise and attention. We received detailed answers to all our questions, and he explained the diagnosis precisely. We didn't have to wait, and there was no rush at all, there was plenty of time left for the examination. Our experience with the receptionist/assistant boys was also positive, everyone was extremely kind. A special plus point is that they didn't talk us into paying extra for the x-ray we had previously suggested, because the doctor didn't think it was justified. Obviously it's not cheap, since this is a specialist appointment that requires special knowledge, but the level of care justifies the fee. It's a special pleasure that due to the professional care, our long-standing problem was resolved in a few days. We left with positive experiences, and if we had a similar problem next time, we would come here again!

I am very satisfied! Dr. Zsolt Sebestyén, if it hadn't been for our dog, we would have had to put him to sleep by now, because he was treated for epilepsy in Austria, they gave him medication but nothing helped, he still had daily seizures.
He knew during his first examination that the dog was not epileptic, he received treatment for the diagnosed disease, and since then (1.5 years) he has been almost symptom-free.
I am very grateful to him! Thank you!
My dog ​​received the best care here.

A dear friend of mine (unfortunately) brought her kitten here, who is now in a state where she is hovering between life and death. 😡
They didn't realize at this place that the kitten had swallowed something that caused her intestinal blockage (they thought it was a virus), they didn't do any tests, she just got an infusion every day.
I would like to mention that she was directly asked if there was something in her intestines, because there was a suspicion that the kitten had swallowed something, but the doctor dismissed it. Unfortunately, he didn't do any tests in this regard.
A few days later, the now bone and skin kitten was taken to another doctor, where it soon turned out that the small object was in her intestines and unfortunately it caused her intestinal blockage!
They performed immediate life-saving surgery on her, and the small bullet she had swallowed was also removed. However, the cat is in such a state that its survival is uncertain because 1 day after the operation it has to be operated again because inflammation occurred due to the feces that remained inside for days…
To sum up: a negligent doctor who does not understand his profession, who is responsible for the suffering or death of who knows how many animals. If someone is not able to diagnose something properly, they should at least send the person to the right place!
Avoid this place if you can!
doctor took good care of my pet highly recommended

Dr. Zsolt Sebestyén is one of the few veterinarians in the country who performs brain surgery on cats, and at prices that are affordable for many. He and his colleagues have successfully operated on our cat twice, always scheduling the …

Our little dachshund was in a lot of pain. Dr. Zsolt Sebestyén thoroughly examined our dog and referred us for an MRI scan that same day, and the surgery took place the next day. The Doctor explained everything very clearly and …

We came in during the hottest part of the summer, without an appointment, with a sudden summer eye infection. No waiting, endless kindness, quick and thorough examination... I wish all our medical examinations were like this ;)
